services.name: Lake Cody Campground
services.desc: Discover affordable and convenient camping options at our beautiful lakeside location. Whether you're planning a short getaway or a long-term stay, we offer a range of site options to suit your needs. Our rates include essential amenities like water, electricity, sewer, swimming, fishing privileges, and basic Wi-Fi. With a variety of camping options from nightly to seasonal, you're sure to find the perfect spot for your next outdoor adventure. Book your stay today and experience the natural beauty and relaxation our campgrounds have to offer! Reserve Your Site Today! We accept reservations and credit card payments (with a service fee). blurb: Welcome to Lake Cody, a family-friendly campground, RV park, and swimming beach located in beautiful northwest Ohio. Our campground features a 15-acre fully stocked lake, 130 spacious campsites, and a scenic mile-long walk path, offering the perfect setting for your next outdoor adventure.
